title: Three ways into a VPC
claim: A data center reaches a VPC through VPN tunnels or a Direct Connect connection, and remote users reach it through Client VPN.
alt: A data center connects to a transit gateway in two ways: two VPN tunnels over the internet, and a Direct Connect connection through a Direct Connect location and a Direct Connect gateway. Remote users connect through a Client VPN endpoint.

edges.label: VPN tunnels
edges.say: The customer gateway device sends traffic through two VPN tunnels, each terminating in a different Availability Zone.

edges.label: fiber cable
edges.say: Direct Connect runs over a standard Ethernet fiber-optic cable from the router to a Direct Connect location.
The transit virtual interface is attached to an AWS Direct Connect gateway, which reaches the transit gateway.

edges.label: VPN client
edges.say: Remote users connect to the Client VPN endpoint using an OpenVPN-based VPN client.
